related.title: ConvNeXt：Patchify 輸入與大核深度卷積
related.titleEn: ConvNeXt: patchify stems and large depthwise kernels
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付倍率預算、取整審核與固定資料集品質比較計畫。；報告包含1.92027與1.452，並明列近似成本不等於端到端延遲。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver scaling budgets, rounding audit and a fixed-dataset quality comparison plan.; Report1.92027 and1.452 and explicitly distinguish approximate cost from end-to-end latency.
related.difference: 畫224×224→56×56的patch網格，明列大核位於降採樣後，非原224×224影像。；計算結果正確且patch數為3136；脈衝峰值與預定中心對齊。
related.differenceEn: Draw224×224→56×56 patches and locate the large kernel after downsampling, not on the original image.; Counts match with3136 patches, and the impulse peak aligns with its intended center.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 卷積主導近似成本倍率為d×w²×r²；忽略取整、固定層與記憶體瓶頸。；教學相對倍率d=1.2,w=1.1,r=1.15；只改r至1.0作對照。；倍率=1.2×1.1²×1.15²=1.92027；r=1時1.452。
無重疊patchify步幅s將H×W縮成H/s×W/s；深度卷積k×k每輸出位置每通道用k² MAC。；教學H=W=224,s=4,C=32,k=7；另比較k=3。；MAC=56²×32×49=4917248；k3時903168。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A convolution-dominated cost scales approximately as d×w²×r², ignoring rounding, fixed layers and memory bottlenecks.; Teaching factors d=1.2,w=1.1,r=1.15; compare r=1.0 with other factors fixed.; Multiplier=1.2×1.1²×1.15²=1.92027; r=1 gives1.452.

Nonoverlapping stride-s patchification gives H/s×W/s positions; a depthwise k×k filter costs k² MACs per channel and position.; Teaching H=W=224,s=4,C=32,k=7, compared with k=3.; MAC=56²×32×49=4917248; k3 gives903168.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: FaceNet：三元組距離與嵌入驗證
related.titleEn: FaceNet: triplet distance and embedding checks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付倍率預算、取整審核與固定資料集品質比較計畫。；報告包含1.92027與1.452，並明列近似成本不等於端到端延遲。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver scaling budgets, rounding audit and a fixed-dataset quality comparison plan.; Report1.92027 and1.452 and explicitly distinguish approximate cost from end-to-end latency.
related.difference: 畫錨、正、負向量的距離表，標明資料角色與平方單位，避免使用真實身分資料。；.1與.05正確，.7案例損失0，平方距離及margin定義一致。
related.differenceEn: Draw anchor-positive-negative distances with roles and squared units, using no real identity data.; Losses.1,.05 and zero at.7 match with consistent squared-distance conventions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 卷積主導近似成本倍率為d×w²×r²；忽略取整、固定層與記憶體瓶頸。；教學相對倍率d=1.2,w=1.1,r=1.15；只改r至1.0作對照。；倍率=1.2×1.1²×1.15²=1.92027；r=1時1.452。
L=max(0,dAP²−dAN²+margin)，必須一致使用平方距離。；教學dAP²=.4,dAN²=.5,margin=.2；改負樣本平方距離.55。；L=.4−.5+.2=.1；改後.4−.55+.2=.05，兩者均大於0。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A convolution-dominated cost scales approximately as d×w²×r², ignoring rounding, fixed layers and memory bottlenecks.; Teaching factors d=1.2,w=1.1,r=1.15; compare r=1.0 with other factors fixed.; Multiplier=1.2×1.1²×1.15²=1.92027; r=1 gives1.452.
L=max(0,dAP²−dAN²+margin), consistently using squared distances.; Teaching dAP²=.4,dAN²=.5,margin=.2; change negative squared distance to.55.; L=.4−.5+.2=.1; changed loss=.05, both above zero.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
